columns.name: Ticker
columns.meaning: Symbol from the watchlist.

columns.name: Date
columns.meaning: Trading date of the latest bar used for the row.

columns.name: Open
columns.meaning: Raw daily open from yfinance.

columns.name: High
columns.meaning: Raw daily high from yfinance.

columns.name: Low
columns.meaning: Raw daily low from yfinance.

columns.name: Close
columns.meaning: Raw daily close from yfinance.

columns.name: Volume (Vol)
columns.meaning: Raw daily share volume (Vol = Volume); basis for all Vol ... columns.

columns.name: OHLC / 4
columns.meaning: A per-bar typical-price proxy standing in for intraday VWAP throughout the watchlist (used by ATR as % Price, DeMark High Low Rank, and Notional Value $M).

columns.name: True Range
columns.meaning: The daily true range of the bar, measured from the OHLC / 4 proxy price instead of the close. It is the input series to Average True Range (ATR).

columns.name: Average True Range (ATR)
columns.meaning: The 21-day average true range anchored at the OHLC / 4 proxy price - a volatility measure in dollar terms.

columns.name: ATR as % Price
columns.meaning: Average True Range (ATR) expressed as a percentage of price. ATR as % Price - 100 is the ATR as a % of price; values well above 100 indicate an expanded daily range relative to price.

columns.name: 52-Wk High
columns.meaning: The 52-week trading range boundary - the upper DeMark High/Low reference level.

columns.name: 52-Wk Low
columns.meaning: The 52-week trading range boundary - the lower DeMark High/Low reference level.

columns.name: 52-Wk Range
columns.meaning: The width of the 52-week high-low range, in dollars.

columns.name: DeMark High Low Rank
columns.meaning: Where the OHLC / 4 price sits inside the 52-week high-low range, on a 0-centered scale of [-50, +50]. Above zero = upper half of the yearly range; below zero = lower half. The sentinel 65.0 is used when the range is zero (rare).

columns.name: Close vs Open %
columns.meaning: Continuously-compounded percent change from the open to the close. Positive = closed above the open; negative = closed below.

columns.name: Vol EMA 21
columns.meaning: The 21-day exponential moving average of volume (Vol). The baseline for Vol % of Vol EMA 21.

columns.name: Vol % of Vol EMA 21
columns.meaning: Current volume relative to its 21-day exponential average. 100 = average activity; >130 = heavy volume; <80 = light volume.

columns.name: Vol Median 21
columns.meaning: The 21-day median volume (Vol) - the baseline for the ticker side of Relative Vol vs QQQ Market.

columns.name: Vol % of Vol Median 21
columns.meaning: The ticker's volume (Vol) as a percentage of its own 21-day median volume. 100 = median activity.

columns.name: Relative Vol vs QQQ Market
columns.formula: log(Vol % of Vol Median 21 / qqqVolPct) * 100   where qqqVolPct = QQQ row's Vol % of Vol Median 21
columns.meaning: The ticker's volume (Vol) normalized against the market's (QQQ's) relative volume, log-scaled. 0 = the stock's volume activity matches the market's; positive = trading on relatively higher volume than the market; negative = lighter.
columns.recompute: log(Vol % of Vol Median 21 / QQQ's Vol % of Vol Median 21) * 100, using the QQQ row for the denominator

columns.name: Notional Value $M
columns.meaning: Dollar value traded for the day in millions (volume weighted at the OHLC / 4 proxy price). A liquidity/participation measure: large, liquid names show high values. Holds the raw numeric value for easy sorting.
